title: Viewing Hardware Overview and Hardware Inventory

blocks.text: Hardware Overview and Hardware Inventory allow you to view current information about your organization's devices and their hardware information based on their associated users.
To view Hardware Overview and Hardware Inventory data, ensure:

blocks.item: The devices have the following:
The minimum required versions of Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module.
The supported OS.
To learn more, see Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility.
Your ZDX subscription level supports Hardware Inventory. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.
Your ZDX role has the proper permission level. To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

blocks.text: You can access Hardware Overview page by going to Digital Experience > Hardware > Hardware Overview.
On the Hardware Overview page, you can:

blocks.item: Use the filters in the Hardware Overview to narrow your scope of inventory information:
Vendors: Supported hardware vendors.
Models: The device model name.
Zscaler Locations: The list of locations where a user accessed a device, as defined in Internet & SaaS. To learn more, see About Locations.
Geolocations: The geographic areas where users access their devices.
View the minimum required Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module versions for supported operating systems.

View the current device count and the total active users from the last 14 days until the start of the UTC day. The percentage on each card indicates how the count has increased or decreased over the past 24 hours.
Hover over the bar charts to view memory distribution and OS distribution:
Memory Distribution: Amount of memory installed and allotted per device.
OS Distribution: Number of devices per OS.

The Hardware Inventory tiles are color-coded according to device, with the size of each tile visually indicating the number of device models relative to other models. Hover over a Hardware Inventory tile to view the total number of users of that device model. If you click a tile, the Hardware Overview is displayed with all models associated with the device and with device users automatically filtered and applied per model.

blocks.text: The Hardware Inventory page provides a current snapshot of your users' devices. You can access the Hardware Inventory page by going to Digital Experience > Hardware > Hardware Inventory.
On the Hardware Inventory page, you can:

blocks.item: Use the filters at the top of the page to narrow your search for a specific device and its associated user.
These are the same filters in the Hardware Overview page.
View the minimum required ZDX Module and Zscaler Client Connector versions for supported operating systems.

View the current device count and the total active users from the last 14 days until the start of the UTC day. The percentage on each card indicates how the count has increased or decreased over the past 24 hours.
Hover over the bar charts to view memory distribution and OS distribution:
Memory Distribution: Amount of memory installed and allotted per device.
OS Distribution: Number of devices per OS.
Capture all device and hardware information within the table in CSV format, click Export, and then click the Download icon. The download process captures all currently known devices.
Configure which columns to display in the table.
View a table with the following information for each listed device:
Name: The vendor device name, with model and OS.
User: The device user.
OS: The OS running on the device.
Vendor: The name of the device provider.
Hardware Model: The specific model name of the device.
CPU: The processor model.
Memory (RAM): The amount of memory installed on the device.
Click a device name to view more device details about a specific device.
Click a user name to view user details about the user associated with the device.
View the total number of devices and select how many items to display on each page.
Navigate through the table pages.
